title: SearchMetadata
description: Execution metadata for a single search. Hand-maintained from `src/types::SearchMetadata` (v0.8.9). Wire keys: English default (v1.0.2 / ADR-0027); PT aliases accepted on deserialize.

selectors_hash.description: FNV-1a hash of the active selector configuration, 16 hex chars.

retries.description: Number of HTTP retries executed (honored since v0.7.8 GAP-WS-57). v1.0.3: renamed from the stale Portuguese spelling `retentativas`; the English wire (ADR-0027) always emitted `retries`, so the old name never matched.

retries_configured.description: v1.0.3: configured `--retries` budget, emitted alongside the executed count. Previously undeclared, which invalidated every envelope under additionalProperties: false.

used_fallback_endpoint.description: v0.9.4: always false in production (Lite fallback removed, GAP-WS-113).

concurrent_fetches.description: Peak concurrent HTTP fetches during this search.

used_chrome.description: v0.9.4 GAP-WS-113: true on happy-path network ops (Chrome-only production).

chrome_attempted.description: v0.8.0+: True if the Chrome-primary search path was attempted (requires chrome feature enabled).

user_agent.description: The User-Agent header that was sent.

identity_used.description: v0.7.10+: 12-hex identity tag from the 12-identity anti-bot pool. Present in success AND failure paths since GAP-WS-60.

cascade_level.description: v0.6.4+: Cascade level reached during the request (0..=4).

used_proxy.description: True if the request went through --proxy.

news_promo_filtered.description: v1.0.3: renamed from the stale Portuguese spelling `news_filtradas_promo`; the English wire (ADR-0027) always emitted `news_promo_filtered`, so the old name never matched.

pre_flight_fired.description: v0.7.9+: True if the pre-flight ghost-block detector fired.

zero_cause.description: v0.8.0+: Causal classification of zero-result scenarios. `zero-results-suspeito` added in GAP-WS-099; `vertical-sem-results` added in v0.8.9 (GAP-WS-104): legitimate zero from the news vertical (rendered SERP without articles), exit 5 — an anti-bot interstitial in the news body still classifies as anti-bot.

bytes_raw.description: v0.8.0+: Raw bytes received from DDG before HTTP decompression (gzip/deflate/br). Null when compression was not used.

bytes_decompressed.description: v0.8.0+: Bytes after HTTP decompression. Null when no compression or no body.

cascade_level_observed.description: v0.8.0+: Cascade level observed during the most recent probe-deep call in the same process. Used by classify_zero_result as cross-signal when pre_flight is not active. v1.0.3: renamed from the stale Portuguese spelling `cascata_nivel_observado`; the English wire (ADR-0027) always emitted `cascade_level_observed`, so the old name never matched.

result_count.description: v0.8.8+: Compat mirror of root-level quantidade_results, populated by fill_compat_fields().

endpoint_used.description: v0.8.8+: Compat mirror of root-level endpoint, populated by fill_compat_fields(). v1.0.3: renamed from the stale Portuguese spelling `endpoint_used_compat`; the English wire (ADR-0027) always emitted `endpoint_used`, so the old name never matched.

vertical_used.description: v0.9.8: Vertical executed. Default search is all (web+news).

run_id.description: Pass 42: UUID v7 correlation id for this search run (hyphenated). Present on production success and failure envelopes.

chrome_path_resolved.description: v0.9.8 agent contract (not telemetry): resolved Chrome/Chromium binary path after shell/Flatpak resolution.

chrome_channel.description: v0.9.8+ agent contract: install channel of the resolved browser (no env channel — CHROME_PATH product env removed).

flags_ignored.description: v1.0.3: legacy or no-op flags the operator passed that the binary deliberately ignored, listed for agent honesty (GAP-E2E-V14-ALLOW-LITE-SILENT-NOOP). Example: ["allow-lite-fallback"] under Chrome-only production (GAP-WS-113). Present since v0.9.x but never declared, so every envelope that carried it was rejected under additionalProperties: false.
